Name: AliveNpcs Personality Editor
Author: LUCASGATICA
Description:
[center][size=6][b]🌿 AliveNpcs Personality Editor[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Create complete NPC and farmer profiles for AliveNpcs[/b][/size]

[size=3]Give the valley your own interpretation. Shape a villager's personality, appearance, lore, social tags, and selected character data — or write the backstory of your farmer — without editing JSON by hand.[/size]

[color=#f0c040][b]AliveNpcs Personality Editor requires AliveNpcs 1.5.0 or later.[/b][/color]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43475][b]Get AliveNpcs here[/b][/url]

[b]Discord:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/8vUfXEH852]https://discord.gg/8vUfXEH852[/url]
[/center]

[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]What Is It?[/b][/size][/center]

AliveNpcs Personality Editor is a standalone companion mod for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43475]AliveNpcs[/url]. It adds a full-screen, Stardew-style in-game manager for the profiles that AliveNpcs uses when generating AI dialogue, memories, gossip, conversations, and story context.

The manager now covers more than personality text. You can edit NPC personality, appearance, lore, social tags, and selected [font=Courier New]Data/Characters[/font] values. A dedicated Farmer tab lets you edit the player character sheet used by AliveNpcs. A community Catalog lets you discover, preview, import, save, and optionally share presets.

This is not a dialogue replacer. It does not change vanilla dialogue, schedules, portraits, heart events, friendship rules, or existing AliveNpcs memories. It changes the profile and optional character data that AliveNpcs receives when building its AI context.

[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]✨ Highlights[/b][/size][/center]

[list]
[*][b]Three main tabs:[/b] Farmer, NPCs, and Catalog.[/*]
[*][b]NPC discovery from AliveNpcs:[/b] the manager lists the NPCs currently accepted by the AliveNpcs compatibility API for the loaded save.[/*]
[*][b]Organized NPC categories:[/b] Bachelors, Bachelorettes, Townspeople, Special, SVE, and Other.[/*]
[*][b]Vanilla, SVE, and custom NPC support:[/b] compatible NPCs from installed mods can appear with their available portraits. SVE fallback personality text is included for Sophia, Victor, Olivia, Andy, Susan, Claire, Martin, Lance, Morris, Scarlett, Morgan, and Apples when AliveNpcs has no default text.[/*]
[*][b]Per-NPC editing:[/b] edit Appearance, Personality, Lore, Social Tags, and optional Submission Credit in a scrollable editor.[/*]
[*][b]Character Data overrides:[/b] optionally edit Display Name, Gender, Manner, Social Anxiety, Optimism, Can Socialize, and Can Be Romanced. These values override the corresponding game data and are clearly marked in the Catalog.[/*]
[*][b]Display-name presentation:[/b] when the experimental Character Data integration is enabled, overridden NPC names are reflected in the portrait/dialogue name layer with an "Originally …" tooltip.[/*]
[*][b]NPC opt-out control:[/b] disable or re-enable all AliveNpcs interactions for an NPC while preserving that NPC's base-game dialogue.[/*]
[*][b]Immediate updates:[/b] saving reloads the custom profile in AliveNpcs, so the next AI conversation can use it without restarting the game. Reset removes only the custom override and restores the AliveNpcs default.[/*]
[*][b]Farmer character sheet:[/b] press [font=Courier New]F7[/font] to edit Who you are, Why you moved to the valley, Extra information, and the optional At-a-glance description. The editor can take over the AliveNpcs F7 character-sheet menu.[/*]
[*][b]Community Catalog:[/b] search and filter shared presets, open redesigned detailed previews, import and apply them, save local presets, upload your own presets, and delete presets when the server grants permission.[/*]
[*][b]Local-first sharing:[/b] Save to Gallery creates a local preset first. Uploading to the community server is a separate, explicit action, so profiles remain private until you choose to share them.[/*]
[*][b]Six UI languages:[/b] English · Português Brasileiro · Español · Français · Deutsch · Italiano.[/*]
[*][b]Safe saves:[/b] JSON is written through temporary files before replacement, reducing the chance of leaving a partially written profile behind.[/*]
[/list]
[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]How To Use It[/b][/size][/center]

[list=1]
[*]Load a save with AliveNpcs enabled.[/*]
[*]Press [font=Courier New]F10[/font] (or your configured NPC editor key). Press [font=Courier New]F7[/font] for the Farmer tab when the character-sheet override is enabled.[/*]
[*]Choose the Farmer, NPCs, or Catalog tab.[/*]
[*]For an NPC, select a category and click a portrait. Write or edit the profile fields, then select [b]Save[/b].[/*]
[*]For a farmer, fill in the four character-sheet fields and select [b]Save[/b].[/*]
[*]Talk to an NPC through AliveNpcs to see the new profile foundation in action.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Reset[/b] removes only the selected NPC override. It does not delete memories, friendship, gossip, relationship history, or other save data created by AliveNpcs.

[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]Character Data and Compatibility[/b][/size][/center]

The optional Character Data section is collapsed and locked by default. Enable it in Generic Mod Config Menu if you want to edit the structured game fields. Character Data changes can affect how an NPC is displayed or treated by the game and may conflict with other mods, so review the warning before applying a Catalog preset containing Character Data.

The editor captures the original values, detects changes made by other mods, restores the protected original values, and displays an in-game notification when a conflict is found. Diagnostics are also sent to AliveNpcs so its prompt builder can account for detected external changes.

There is a separate experimental setting, [b]Include Character Data in prompt[/b]. It is off by default because structured fields can make an AI character contradict its written personality or invent details. Enable it only if you are actively testing it.

[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]Writing Good Personality Profiles[/b][/size][/center]

The best profiles give the model direction without turning the character into a list of commands. Start with temperament and values, then add social habits, interests, speech style, boundaries, or a personal tension.

[spoiler]
[b]Example[/b]

[i]Sebastian is private and dryly funny, using sarcasm when he feels cornered. He values independence and notices when someone respects his space. Around trusted friends he becomes unexpectedly playful and talks more openly about technology, music, and leaving town one day. He avoids loud emotional scenes, but will quietly show up when someone needs him.[/i]

[b]Tips[/b]
[list]
[*]Keep a recognizable core so the NPC still feels coherent over many days.[/*]
[*]Describe how they react to trust, conflict, affection, gossip, or boundaries.[/*]
[*]Use concrete details sparingly: a few strong details are more useful than a long biography.[/*]
[*]If you want canon-like behavior, adapt the existing text instead of replacing it completely.[/*]
[*]Avoid instructions such as “always agree with the farmer.” Personality works best when an NPC can still have their own point of view.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]Community Catalog[/b][/size][/center]

The Catalog can connect to a community gallery server. Its default server is:

[code]https://stardewproxy.techryo.uk/galeria/[/code]
Use [b]Discover[/b] to search shared presets by text or NPC, preview their fields, and import them. Use [b]Local[/b] to manage presets saved on your computer, apply them to an NPC or farmer, upload them explicitly, or delete local copies. A preset with Character Data is marked and requires confirmation before it is applied.

You can disable the Catalog entirely with [font=Courier New]GalleryEnabled[/font] or change the server URL in the configuration or in the Catalog's [b]Server[/b] dialog.

[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]Compatibility and Safety[/b][/size][/center]

[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley Expanded:[/b] supported when installed and enabled in AliveNpcs.[/*]
[*][b]Other NPC mods:[/b] compatible NPCs can appear in the Other tab.[/*]
[*][b]AliveNpcs compatibility rules:[/b] the editor only lists NPCs accepted by the current AliveNpcs API. It does not bypass AliveNpcs compatibility settings or the community AI opt-out dataset.[/*]
[*][b]Gameplay safety:[/b] this editor only changes profiles and selected character data; it does not disable AliveNpcs' safety guardrails.[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer:[/b] NPC overrides are global to the mod installation. Players who want the same NPC profiles should use the same files. Farmer character sheets remain save-specific.[/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu:[/b] optional. The editor works with its own menu and [font=Courier New]config.json[/font]; GMCM adds convenient settings for the experimental Character Data prompt, Catalog, and server URL.[/*]
[*][b]AI provider:[/b] AliveNpcs still needs its normal AI-provider configuration. This editor does not require a separate API key or AI service.[/*]
[/list]

[center][size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size][/center]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43475]AliveNpcs 1.4.5 or later[/url].[/*]
[*]Download AliveNpcs Personality Editor.[/*]
[*]Extract the folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/*]

[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]Configuration and Data[/b][/size][/center]

The first launch creates [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] in the mod folder:

[code]
{
  "OpenEditorKey": "F10",
  "OpenFarmerTabKey": "F7",
  "OverrideCharacterSheet": true,
  "GalleryServerUrl": "https://stardewproxy.techryo.uk/galeria/",
  "GalleryEnabled": true,
  "IncludeCharacterDataInPrompt": false
}[/code]
Hotkeys accept valid SMAPI button names. [font=Courier New]OverrideCharacterSheet[/font] controls whether this editor handles [font=Courier New]F7[/font]. [font=Courier New]GalleryEnabled[/font] controls the Catalog tab and sharing buttons. [font=Courier New]IncludeCharacterDataInPrompt[/font] is the experimental, off-by-default AI setting described above.

NPC overrides are stored as one JSON file per NPC in the editor's [font=Courier New]overrides[/font] folder. Local Catalog presets are stored separately in [font=Courier New]presets[/font]. Older [font=Courier New]custom_personalities.json[/font] files are migrated to the per-NPC format and backed up as [font=Courier New].bak[/font] when the next save occurs. Farmer sheets remain save-specific under AliveNpcs' [font=Courier New]Data/<saveId>/character_sheet.json[/font] path.
